work.name: University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
work.summary: Developed CliPP-on-Web to bring subclonal reconstruction to clinicians and quantified compartment-specific plasticity. Mined pre- and post-treatment SNV/CNV profiles from clinical trials to detect emerging resistance, monitor disease trajectory, and link signals to outcomes (response, PFS/OS) and biomarker signatures.
